name: Hanazono Emi
source:
A first year at Hanyuu Academy, and a year younger than her childhood friend, [url=/c78405]Ryoutarou[/url], whom she reunited with when he moved back to Japan.

Emi and Ryoutarou were so close when they were kids that she’d call him Big Brother... despite her already having a big brother, [url=/c82770]Tooru[/url]. Although she used to be bossy when she was young and always forced Ryoutarou and Tooru to do what she wanted, she’s become much friendlier now that she’s grown up, and is deeply ashamed of the way she used to act.

“N-No, it’s... way too embarrassing to call you Big Brother now.”

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1490&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
